pixel_description: Photorealistic studio render only: L-shaped hand truck tilted on concrete steps with brown parcel. CRITICAL BB: drawn as two elements, two parallel large silver tubes side-by-side, running from lower axle housing up to top handle, joined by clamp collars and mid cross-collar, with diagonal clip brace pinned mid-tube to lower frame. Connected at top telescopically to thinner handle tubes sliding inside, at bottom rigidly to axle/toe bracket and gear hub. TP: single flat silver plate horizontal under parcel, hinged to BB root via bracket. HR: handle assembly of two thin silver sliding tubes plus top transverse housing with two black grips, small black lever blades under grips, black cable from lever down along BB to axle. CL: rear tri-star with central hub and three radiating arms each with small swivel caster wheel on ground, plus front small caster wheel on step edge attached to horizontal frame linked to BB; matches 2 clusters side-by-side in perspective. AX: central hub at toothed gear center at BB root. BR: large silver toothed disc/gear at root with caliper on frame. LV: dead-man lever plus cable. CB: diagonal silver stay from BB mid to front frame. PS: black webbing strap vertical around parcel sides and horizontal over top. Parcel sits on TP. Steps: three light concrete steps right. No person. Seven grey callouts with leader lines. Size: no hands, steps riser gives scale, truck height ~5 risers, parcel moderate, proportions match 1200mm-class truck, shape is stair hand-truck, not van-size box.

BB is continuous with HR telescoping tubes at top and hinged to TP bracket at root, and strap runs behind parcel to backrest. Size 8.9x is false because segmenter measured HR as black grip only, not full handle tubes. Tilt and contacts are correct, does not change load path.

Size 0.11x is false because only black grip tip segmented, not full sliding tubes. HR slides inside BB, they touch.

Anchors behind parcel to backrest/toe, occluded by box. Vertical orientation is correct for preload, size small vs 1100mm tubes but strap spec up to 1200mm length, wrapped portion short. Contact exists behind parcel.

Size 0.2 vs 0.41 is foreshortening, wheels ~150mm vs cluster dia ~370mm correct order, walking principle unchanged.
pixels show each of the two backbone tubes tilted same as BB assembly in deployed climbing posture, matching sketch. Vertical would be unfolded upright, not stair pull. Tilt required, not fault.

deviations.expected: device ~1200mm across, folded 1145x380x190mm fits van diagonal

No person for scale, stairs and parcel provide scale and look domestic. Coarse scaling inflated by mis-segmented HR/BB ratio. Shape is L hand-truck, not oversize box, suitable for stairs and diagonal van stow. No limit broken in deployed state.

s1_differences: Mechanism same as sketch: twin-tube backbone, toe-plate with parcel and strap, telescoping handle with lever and cable to disc/tooth brake on main axle, tri-star on ground plus wheel on step, diagonal brace, spring. Same connections, same tilted pull orientation, same relative sizes. Only difference is depiction: Folding Toe Plate callout leader ends on parcel top, not plate. No missing or extra working part.
s2_feedback: No design flaw visible in faithful render. Load path toe-plate to backbone to axle to clusters intact, brake disc on axle with cable release, brace triangulates, no interference, no unreachable part, spring and cable have clearance from steps.
notes: Segmenter coarse x2, long-axis only. All contacts reported apart are present in pixels but occluded or cable-mediated. Tilts match sketch deployed pull posture, not vertical. Whole-device 1544x1573mm is scaling artefact from HR grip-only measurement; against 197mm riser steps device proportions match 1100mm backbone, 185mm cluster radius, 150mm wheels. No people in render, parcel and steps give plausible 60kg truck scale, L-shape as problem asks, not oversize.
